mutations.name: the count-up shows the spring's overshoot
kills: a stat card counting up to its figure the count never shows a value past its figure

mutations.name: a version tag counts up like a quantity
kills: a stat card whose figure is not a plain count draws a version whole from its first frame while the currency beside it counts up

mutations.name: the figure is rounded to one decimal
kills: a stat card whose figure is not a plain count settles on every decimal the figure has, so 13.41 is not rounded to 13.4
